Subject: EOQ Sprint: Finalize ownership & finance handoff

Hi Sofia / Jake —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock the remaining milestones into the EOQ commit window by COB Thu so your renewal is included in this quarter's revenue. I attached a lightweight commit tracker and the latest SOW with the two changes we agreed on (term language + usage caps).

Ask for Stratus: please confirm the final PO value for the December invoice and whether finance will approve net-45 or need net-30. If net-45 is acceptable we can keep the price as quoted; if you need net-30 Ben (cc) can run through early payment incentive options.

Internal owners:
- Priyom: lead on commercial redlines and final pricing note (owner for counter-sign)
- Laura: operational acceptance and billing contact follow-up (owner for invoicing details)
- Ben: early-pay discount options if finance needs net-30

Timeline:
- Wed EOD: legal/commercial signoff and SOW ready for signature
- Thu COB: PO + billing confirmation from Stratus to guarantee quarter inclusion

Sofia — can you confirm PO value and target payment terms today or tomorrow morning? If you want a quick call to finalize we can do 20 minutes midday.

Attachments: commit_tracker_2026-12-01.xlsx (summary tab + line items), SOW_Stratus_v3.pdf (redlines highlighted)

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@stratusmedia.com>

Cc: Jake Peterson <jake.peterson@stratusmedia.com>, finance@stratusmedia.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EOQ Sprint: Finalize ownership & finance handoff

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- PO value: we will route for $215,000 (matches the tracker line item #3).
- Payment terms: finance is pushing net-30 for internal policy. I looped finance@ for official confirmation.

If net-30 is required, can you confirm the incremental delta if we take Ben's early-pay arrangement? Also, we will aim to get a signed PO by Thu but may need a day to get final approvals depending on legal scheduling.

If it's helpful I can have Jake jump on a short call with Priyom to square the commercial language.

—Sofia
VP, Customer Success
Stratus Media

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EOQ Sprint: Finalize ownership & finance handoff

Karthik — looping back with a concrete path if Stratus needs net-30.

Options (short):
1) Standard quote, net-45 (no change) — best for Redwood coverage of cashflow but requires buyer acceptance
2) Net-30 with 1.5% early-pay fee credit (i.e., invoice shows 1.5% discount if paid within 15 days) — reduces our effective revenue by ~1.5% for this invoice
3) Net-30 + 30% upfront (partial prepay) — mitigates risk and preserves near-full revenue recognition for the quarter

I recommend option 2 as the simplest compromise. Ben, can you confirm the discount mechanics and whether we should push for a partial prepay instead? Laura, please confirm whether invoicing to finance@stratusmedia.com with PO ref will be sufficient.

I will prepare a final commercial note and a redline summary for Sofia and Jake by end of day. If legal needs to approve the SOW redlines I will include a one-page summary for quick signoff to speed the loop.

—Priyom
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@stratusmedia.com>, Jake Peterson <jake.peterson@stratusmedia.com>, finance@stratusmedia.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 17:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EOQ Sprint: Finalize ownership & finance handoff

Thanks everyone — consolidated next steps below so we can close this into the quarter.

Confirmed items:
- PO amount: $215,000 (Sofia confirmed)
- Preferred payment: Stratus requests net-30; finance@ copied for formal approval

Redwood path forward (owners):
- Priyom: finalize commercial note with option 2 language (1.5% early-pay credit) and upload an annotated SOW for quick legal acceptance — due Wed EOD (PRIYOM OWNER)
- Ben: craft the invoice language for the early-pay credit, include term codes for revenue ops — due Thu 10:00am (BEN OWNER)
- Laura: confirm billing contact and PO acceptance method; confirm email to use for invoicing — due Thu 12:00pm (LAURA OWNER)

External ask for Stratus: please try to circulate the signed PO by Thu COB; if you need a 20-minute call tomorrow to accelerate signoff, Jake and I are available 10:30–11:30am PT. If finance approves net-30 today that will be sufficient to proceed.

I am attaching the commit tracker with owners filled in and a one-page redline summary (SOW_Stratus_v3.pdf). Let me know if you want us to draft the DocuSign envelope when the PO is ready — we can handle that immediately to capture the signature window.

Attachments referenced: commit_tracker_2026-12-01.xlsx, SOW_Stratus_v3.pdf

Best,
Karthik
